text: {"lessons":["I’ve repeatedly sold winners to lock in gains, but a gain versus my average cost alone doesn’t show whether selling is best; I should weigh each stock’s outlook and portfolio role.","My account value fell across several periods despite realizing gains, so I should judge decisions by total portfolio performance, not the satisfaction of a profitable sale.","Losses feel especially painful, but I should avoid letting my purchase price dictate whether I hold; use a consistent risk-based plan and keep enough diversification and cash."]}
